entities.summary: Tatamá National Natural Park is a national park in the Cordillera Occidental, Colombia. Established in 1987, the park encompasses 51,900 ha of primary west-Andean tropical and subtropical rainforest, temperate cloud forest, and páramo habitat in an area that spans the departments of Risaralda, Chocó and Valle del Cauca, within the Chocó bioregion.
